test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per Economic Survey 2021-22, the _________ sector contributed the most to the GDP of India during the year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Service.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the Economic Survey 2021-2022, **The Service sector has seen a growth rate of** 8.2% and contributed over 50% of India's GDP in 2021-2022.**
 
• **Nirmala Sithraman** presented the Economic Survey 2021-22 in Parliament on **31st January 2022.**
 
• Some other fiscal developments as per the Survey are as follows:
 
 
• **The revenue receipts**(April-November 2021) from Central Government have **gone up by 67.2%.**
 
• Gross Tax Revenue registered a growth of over 50% ( April-November 2021).
 
• **Central Government debt has gone up from 49.1%(2019-20) to 59.3%(2020-21) of GDP**
 
 
 
• As per the Economic Survey 2021-22,** the foreign exchange reserves touched USD 633.6 billion(as of Dec 31, 2021).**
 
• According to the Economic Survey 2021-22, the repo rate was maintained at 4% in 2021-22.
 
• The Economic Survey also revealed that** Rs. 89,066** crores was raised via **75 Initial Public Offering (IPO) **issues in April-November 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The Economic Survey was first released in 1950-51 and presented with the budget until 1964.
 
• The Economic Survey was separated from the budget after 1964.
 
• V Anantha Nageswaran is the current Chief Economic Advisor(CEA).
